system_goal: Build a Customer Support Triage system with specialized sub-agents for intent classification, sentiment analysis, and escalation routing.

agents.name: intent_classifier
agents.instruction: Classify incoming customer support tickets into intent categories (billing, technical, account, general).

agents.name: sentiment_analyzer
agents.instruction: Analyze customer sentiment (positive, neutral, urgent, frustrated) to determine priority.

agents.name: escalation_router
agents.instruction: Route tickets based on intent and sentiment to human agents, automated response, or tier-2 support.
